frame —/— · t=—
MOTION LAW — the animation is evaluated from the GLB's own channels: slerp between keys, joints composed up the node graph, vertices blended against inverseBindMatrices. No library, no fetch. Onion ghosts are gold→cyan by time, exactly like the baked strip. If a file has channels but no skin, the bare joint hierarchy animates instead — honest motion beats fake skinning.
